articles.title: Raku Glaze
articles.summary: Fine diagonal crosshatch mesh in gloss grey, regular woven pattern with slight sparkle. A grey panel with warm copper-gold crazing that clumps into diagonal streaks; from distance it reads as a speckled copper-lustre veil, not discrete cracks.

Up close: A fine web of copper-orange hairline cracks (a few px wide) running over the paint, thickest in diagonal bands, over a faint soft diamond-grid of darker and lighter squares. The surface between cracks keeps your own colour (grey here). From a distance: A grey panel with warm copper-gold crazing that clumps into diagonal streaks; from distance it reads as a speckled copper-lustre veil, not discrete cracks. Measured spec (average): metal 150, roughness 51, coat 68. Shine: gloss. Metal: medium. It takes the colour you give the zone.

Up close: Very fine flowing parallel lines that swirl around a few whorl points like a fingerprint or wood grain, pale straw-yellow ribbons separated by thin blue-grey lines, with scattered reddish and violet flecks in patches. Line spacing is only a few pixels. From a distance: Reads as a straw-gold metal with a fine silvery-blue grain and faint rainbow patches; the lines melt into a shimmering brushed texture with swirling light drift. Measured spec (average): metal 175, roughness 64, coat 100. Shine: satin. Metal: high. It brings its own colours.

articles.title: Terrazzo
articles.summary: Flat speckled terrazzo floor look: light and dark stone chips scattered evenly through the surface, semi-matte, almost no shine. Reads as your colour with a fine salt-and-pepper speckle, matte and quiet; chips merge into a light grain.
articles.what: Terrazzo — stone chips set in your colour and ground flat, some white, some black. Up close: Takes your colour; on grey input it is a flat semi-matte field with sparse tiny round chips, 4-8 px, some bright white and some near-black, plus fuzzy light halos. Chips are scattered thinly and evenly, with no large stones. From a distance: Reads as your colour with a fine salt-and-pepper speckle, matte and quiet; chips merge into a light grain. Measured spec (average): metal 1, roughness 176, coat 147. Shine: semi-matte. Metal: none. It takes the colour you give the zone.

articles.title: Verdigris
articles.summary: Copper patina crust: green verdigris with raw bronze showing in the cracks, fine texture, satin with sparkle. Reads as a busy mint-green and rusty-brown mottle, like an old copper roof or a bronze statue; from far the two tones average into a weathered green-brown speckle.
articles.what: Copper patina in a labyrinth — green crust, raw bronze in the channels. Up close: A fine maze of mint and sea-green crust blobs with small darker dimples, joined into winding labyrinth shapes over a brown-bronze ground showing through the channels. Blobs are a few pixels to fingertip sized; some zones are greener, others browner. Green and bronze are built in. From a distance: Reads as a busy mint-green and rusty-brown mottle, like an old copper roof or a bronze statue; from far the two tones average into a weathered green-brown speckle. Measured spec (average): metal 111, roughness 114, coat 118. Shine: satin. Metal: medium. It takes the colour you give the zone.

articles.title: Volcanic Obsidian
articles.summary: Glassy black volcanic rock: smooth curved fracture shells stepping into dead-black stone, satin sheen, low sparkle. A dark surface covered in grey spiderweb cracks, like a windscreen hit many times; the rosette centres and rings stay readable and the ground is a dark grainy mottle.
articles.what: Conchoidal fracture — glassy shells stepping down into dead-black rock. Up close: Overlapping impact-crack stars: about a dozen cobweb rosettes 100-200 px wide, each a small ring centre with spoke lines and concentric rings, drawn as pale grey threads on a dark speckled ground (shown on neutral grey; it takes your colour). Cracks cross and stack like shattered glass. From a distance: A dark surface covered in grey spiderweb cracks, like a windscreen hit many times; the rosette centres and rings stay readable and the ground is a dark grainy mottle. Measured spec (average): metal 49, roughness 91, coat 89. Shine: satin. Metal: low. It takes the colour you give the zone.

Bold stripes and lettering: read on the dark ground

Avoid: big dark areas vanish in the sim, black numbers disappear.

articles.title: Wire Brushed
articles.summary: Wire-brushed metal: fine swirl scratches sweeping one way, bright on the crests, satin metallic with strong shine. A gritty brushed-metal tone with faint vertical banding; swirl detail dissolves into a fine, slightly dirty metallic texture with pale streaks.
articles.what: Wire-wheel swirl scratches sweeping across the metal, bright on the crests. Up close: Over your colour (shown grey; it takes your colour) a dense tangle of tiny swirling scratch squiggles, 3-10 px, like a wire wheel gouging, with soft lighter vertical streaks about 6 px wide spaced every 40 px, leaning slightly right. Dark pits and light ridges give a gritty, chewed-up look. From a distance: A gritty brushed-metal tone with faint vertical banding; swirl detail dissolves into a fine, slightly dirty metallic texture with pale streaks. Measured spec (average): metal 197, roughness 61, coat 78. Shine: satin. Metal: high. It takes the colour you give the zone.
